questions.stem_text:
Which of the following are trends to emerge in the global defence trade since the end of
the Cold War?

options.A: A growing effort by governments to prevent the spread of weapons, especially of WMDs.
options.B: A growth in volume of the arms trade.
options.C: A change in the nature of the defence trade, linked to the changing nature of conflict.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All of these options.

questions.stem_text: Which factor is cited by Revisionists as the primary cause of the Cold War?

options.A: The threat posed by the Soviet Union

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Domestic concerns of the US

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following phrases is not likely to indicate legitimacy in the new terminology
of RMA?
How did the 2008 financial crisis affect America's international reputation?

options.A: It damaged support for the US model of political economy and capitalism
options.B: It created anger at the United States for exaggerating the crisis
options.C: It increased support for American global leadership under President Obama
options.D: It reduced global use of the US dollar

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It damaged support for the US model of political economy and capitalism
